At Fordham University,

We Stand For What Matters Most

Apply now Visit us Explore programs
This background video features fly-by footage of our Rose Hill campus, our Lincoln Center campus and London Center location.
Scroll

Doing Good That Becomes Greater As The Jesuit University of New York

We’re located in New York City—driven by our Jesuit values and tackling today’s most pressing issues at the center of the world stage.

Learn about us

We Are Leaders, Dreamers, Achievers, And Doers

With sound hearts, strong minds, and the wisdom to take charge, generations of Rams have found what they have needed to grow—the opportunities, connections, and support of this community.

Our Internship Promise

Stephanie Lane, Video Producer Intern at iHeartMedia

“The Fordham name helped make my resume stand out at these bigger companies where I never thought I would have a chance. Being able to do an internship in this city, like the greatest city in the world for my industry, it really helped.”

Theo Vandenberg, Rotational Associate Intern at New York Life

“I had the chance to connect with individuals both within my team and across the organization. And now, having a full-time job offer at the start of my senior year makes me feel very confident and secure. Fordham set me up very well to succeed in a place like this.”

Carley Walker, Performance Marketing Associate Intern at Hearst

“I get to work at the company that owns Cosmo and Elle and Harper's Bazaar, and get to pass all these cool people at work every day and know I’m part of it. It’s very much a dream come true for me.”

John Garza, Sacristan Assistant Intern at Trinity Church

“This was my first job ever. It’s taught me a lot of skills, like how to be a good team member. It was a lot of work. It was a lot of responsibility. But the people were amazing. That makes me feel good about where I work.”

Julia Sosa, Montefiore Health Opportunities Program Intern

“The meaningful relationships I was able to build throughout this program really showed me how important networking and having mentors is. And I have an amazing support system, especially at Fordham.”

From Winding Elms to Bustling City Blocks

With residential campuses in the Bronx and Manhattan, as well as campuses in Westchester and London, Fordham provides endless opportunities to start working toward your career and building the life you want.

  • Plan your visit
  • Explore our Campuses
  • Maps & Directions
  • Virtual Visit
NO LINK

Fordham & America250

From our historic campus to the frontlines of constitutional law, see how the Ram community is celebrating 250 years of the American experiment.

Read more
200K alumni around the world
18% first-gen college students
17K students
14:1 ratio of undergrad to teachers

View more fast facts

AI for the Greater Good

Here at Fordham we are preparing our community—students, faculty, staff, and neighbors—to harness the power of artificial intelligence with wisdom, justice, and ethical discernment.

Explore AI at Fordham

 

We’re Drawn to Where We’re Needed Most

Explore how our values come to life: how Fordham’s students, faculty, and alumni contribute to society and make lives better.

See why Fordham is making news

Ram Pride

Fordham Rises in U.S. News Rankings

Fordham rose 12 spots to No. 85 among national universities in the 2027 Best Colleges rankings released by U.S. News & World Report. The jump places Fordham in the top 20% of national universities, advancing the University’s standing among the country’s top institutions.

Read more

Fordham's New York

Fordham Teams Up with the New York Liberty

Fordham Alumni

Denzel Washington and Anthony Carter on Finding Themselves at Fordham

Living the Mission

Historic Gift Will Expand Social Work Opportunities and Student Internships

All About the Class of 2030

Fordham Welcomes the 2nd Largest Class in University’s History

Living the Mission

Notice of Nondiscriminatory Policy:

Fordham University admits students of any race, color, national and ethnic origin to all the rights, privileges, programs, and activities generally accorded or made available to students at the school. It does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national and ethnic origin in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and loan programs, and athletic and other school-administered programs.

Fordham University is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principle of equal opportunity in education and employment in compliance with Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, Title VI and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Age Discrimination Act of 1975, the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, the Violence Against Women Act, and other federal, state, and local laws.
